_comment: Where the Projects UI bundle (agentic_os/projects_ui) comes from. On the converged trunk it is NOT tracked in git: scripts/fetch_projects_ui.py (run by the wheel build hook, so by `pip install -e .` too) unpacks the pinned artifact packaging/ui-artifacts/projects-ui-root-e6032e8e.tgz (packaging/projects_ui.lock.json) into agentic_os/projects_ui, offline. Read by packaging/sbom/generate_source_offer.py and packaging/sbom/analyze.py and checked against the files by tests/test_ui_bundle_source_record.py. RE-PINNED 2026-11-19: the source commit is now a PUBLISHED commit of the public redevops-projects repository (source_commit_published: true) -- see packaging/projects_ui.lock.json's own _comment for why (the previous local, unpublished commit this bundle was built from was lost in the 2026-11-07 scratchpad wipe and could not be recovered; this build drops the features that only existed there). index.html, the JavaScript and the CSS are build output; hero.jpg is not (D-LIC-8 option c: it is dropped, never packed). RE-PINNED 2026-11-24 to e6032e8e (redevops-projects PRs #28 and #29 on top of 2bbb9811).
source_status: public commit on the redevops-projects repository's own main branch, reachable today at https://github.com/redevops-io/redevops-projects/commit/5ad1ebbca673fa25f5fcec5a56a125ff20d517be ("Portable page: one list of unavailable dashboards; kernel 0.4.16 (0.3.9)", #40; release tag v0.3.9); descends from the public v0.2.0 release (base_commit) via PR #24 (shared routing, restore-last-place and connection states), PR #25 (agent audit findings) and #26.
previous_bundle: the entire previous local-source lineage (assets/index-76LJRJ18.js sha256 828bb55cbbdbc60df8ecad9fffc76ec3c0d2ba918c9b072d0d1d92b3a728649c, built from the now-unrecoverable local commit ea9e53e5, and its own ancestor chain back through 9a1788b1/5751e9e5/312a811a/2f24719e/ee958a01/2fdef7f5) is superseded; see packaging/projects_ui.lock.json's previous_pin for the full chain, kept as history.

build.environment: env -i with PATH, throwaway HOME and TMPDIR, LANG and an isolated npm cache; VITE_PROJECTS_API=/ is the only build variable passed
build.reproduced: built once on 2026-11-25 from a clean `git archive` of the source commit in a throwaway HOME, TMPDIR and npm cache (env -i, node v24.22.3, npm 11.19.1); index.html, the JavaScript and the CSS are byte-identical to the files of the published v0.3.9 release asset.

artifact.url_note: no GitHub Release of this artifact has been published yet; a later publication only fills in the lock's url

lock_change_since_base: compared package by package with the v0.2.0 base: the five production packages (react, react-dom and what they need) are byte-identical entries (same version and integrity); the root entry changed (version 0.3.9, one script, one devDependency) and one dev-only package was added, pyodide 0.27.7 (MPL-2.0), which the build of this artifact does not use
environment_flags_note: the only build variable is VITE_PROJECTS_API=/; VITE_PROJECTS_SAMPLE_DATA no longer exists in this source line either

lock_dev_additions_since_base.name: pyodide
lock_dev_additions_since_base.used_by: npm run build:portable only (the portable dashboards page, a separate release asset); no pyodide code is in this artifact (index.html and the three files under assets/ contain no occurrence of 'pyodide')
